thread:
sam: Kicking off prod deploy for realtime-routing v2 now. Will toggle feature flag with ramp plan.

deploy-bot: Started CI -> canary -> prod workflow for service/realtime-routing:deploy-2026-03-10. Canary to 5% completed.

maria: @sam thanks — what's the FF name and rollback criteria?

sam: Flag is realtime-routing-v2 (platform/flags). Ramp plan: 5% canary -> 25% after 10m -> 50% after 30m -> 100% after 1h if metrics look good. Rollback if p95 latency increases > 100ms above baseline or error-rate > 0.8% over 5m.

liam: Noted. I'll watch latency dashboards. pinning image tag to avoid drift: routing:2026-03-10-642b.

devex: Release notes: https://redwood.example.com/releases/realtime-routing-v2 — includes config changes and fallback behavior.

sam: Running ffctl commands now:
```
# enable 5% canary
ffctl set realtime-routing-v2 --env=prod --percent=5 --reason="canary deploy 2026-03-10"
```

deploy-bot: Feature flag realtime-routing-v2 set to 5% in prod by sam. AuditID: ff-7b3e.

sre-oncall: Watching error budget and request latency. I'll ping at 5m and 15m marks.

maria: Quick heads-up: we're keeping old routing as fallback pinned to routing:2026-02-28 in case we need immediate revert.

liam: Canary looks fine so far (0.02% errors, p95 +12ms). Proceed when you want.

sam: advancing to 25% per plan.

ffctl: Updating flag realtime-routing-v2 -> 25% (actor=sam).

deploy-bot: Autoscaler adjusted for increased throughput. No alerts.

sre-oncall: 10m check — p95 +18ms, error-rate 0.03%. All green.

maria: Proceed to 50% after 20 more minutes unless anything changes.

sam: Scheduling 50% ramp now, will monitor next 30m. If p95 > baseline+100ms or errors >0.8% -> rolling rollback.

liam: After 12m into 50%: seeing occasional 502s from a subset of hosts (3/24). Investigating service mesh config.

sre-oncall: Alert raised: 502 spikes to 0.6% over 1m. Still under threshold but trending.

maria: Pause further ramp to 50% -> back to 25% while we debug. sam can you run kill switch?

sam: Running quick rollback of the flag to 25%: `ffctl set realtime-routing-v2 --env=prod --percent=25 --reason="pause ramp due to 502 spike"`

deploy-bot: Feature flag realtime-routing-v2 set to 25% (actor=sam).

liam: Root cause: envoy config for nodepool-a had stale listener timeout causing resets under new routing pattern. Patch in progress, will roll out envoy fix to nodepool-a.

sre-oncall: Watching after envoy patch; will signal when stable for another ramp.

maria: After patch, run a small smoke canary (5% in nodepool-a) before global ramp. Also add short-circuit metric: 502 rate per nodepool.

sam: Agreed. Plan: deploy envoy patch -> 5% targeted to nodepool-a -> if stable 15m, continue to 50% global. I'll update the release notes with the rollback and fixing steps.

devex: Added note to the release page: "Paused ramp 25% -> investigating 502s on nodepool-a; envoy fix deployed; re-ramp plan in thread."

liam: Envoy patch deployed to nodepool-a. Observability shows 502s back to baseline.

sre-oncall: 15m post-patch: p95 +10ms, 502s 0.01%. OK to proceed.

sam: Targeted 5% to nodepool-a: `ffctl set realtime-routing-v2 --env=prod --percent=5 --scope=nodepool-a`

deploy-bot: Feature flag realtime-routing-v2 set to 5% for scope=nodepool-a (actor=sam).

maria: Smoke looks good, proceed to 50% global on a cautious path: 25% -> 50% with 10m checks.

sam: Rolling to 50% now.

deploy-bot: Update: realtime-routing-v2 -> 50% in prod.

sre-oncall: 10m check: all green. No rollback required.

liam: Final step: 100% after 1h if no regressions. I'll monitor until then.

maria: TL;DR: we paused at 25% after transient 502s, fixed envoy, did a nodepool-targeted smoke, then resumed ramp. Change window unchanged.

sam: Closing thread once we hit 100%. Will post final note. :party-parrot:

deploy-bot: Completed rollout: realtime-routing-v2 set to 100% in prod. AuditID: ff-7b3e. Completed by sam.

sam: DONE — 100% live. Final metrics: p95 +9ms, error-rate delta +0.01%. Rolling notes added to release page.
